chat.t: Um...
Do you, by any chance, accept slightly unusual requests?

o: An unusual request?

chat.t: Like... asking you to be my friend...

o: Hm, well, it's not impossible, but...
For how long?

chat.t: Oh...
Then, just for a day...
I-I wasn't sure how much I should pay you...
I-I'm sorry if I was rude!

o: Should we meet up and talk first?
Where are you right now?

chat.t: Huh?
Y-You're coming here?

o: That'd be much easier, wouldn't it?
I'll head over, so just send me your location.

chat.t: asdfghjklasdfghjklasdfghjklasdfghjkl
I-I'm sorry...
Whenever board games come up, I just go wild before I even realize it...

o: Well, it was fun in its own way.
Though I was a bit surprised at first.

chat.t: I'm glad...
Um...
Is it okay if I message you again sometime?
I really want to play board games with you again...

o: Sure, whenever I'm not busy.

chat.t: Y-Yes! Thank you so much!

lines.t: Vermont Street
She said it was around here...
...But where is she?
H-Huuu... W-What should I do...
(I hear a strange voice coming from somewhere...)
M-Meeting someone I just met today... r-right away... I-I can't...
H-Heeeing... It's almost time...
C-Cutie... w-what should I do...?
M-Maybe I should cancel even now and pay the fee—
Hands up!!!
Hyaaaah!!!!
Huh?? Wa— Arghhh!!
(A moment later)
I'm sorry! I'm sorry! I'm sorry for even being alive!
No, I haven't even said anything yet—
I'll give you all the money I have for this, so please forgive me!
Hmm, yes. An excellent attitude. I shall forgive you.
...Y-Yes? M-My attitude...?
Well, it's a joke. Technically, I was the one who startled you...
Anyway, you're Aronne, right?
Yes... th-that's right...
{player}, are... are you the one who accepted my request...?
I-I'm so sorry for making you come all the way here, but...
Could we pretend this request never happened...?
Huh? All of a sudden?
I-I thought it was too presumptuous of someone like me...
A-And, thinking about it calmly, I felt it would be rude to {player}...
O-Of course, I'll pay the fee!
...Ah! I-In that case, I need to prepare more money...
Wait, before that, I've got a question.
Why did you even make a request to find a friend in the first place?
Huh? Th-That's...
I wanted to play... b-board games... with a friend...
Hmm.
Alright, I get it. We'll cancel the request then.
Y-Yes... I-I'm truly sorry...
Okay, now let's play some board games.
Y-Yes... then I'll transfer the payment—
Huh? U-Um... w-what did you just say...?
You said you wanted to play board games.
Let's do it. Let's play.
...R-Really?
You're really going to play with me? A board game...?
Since I came all this way, playing a few rounds is no big deal.
YesIreallyreallyloveboardgames
butIhavenoonetoplaywithsoIhaventbeenableto
mymomandmybigsistersplaywithmesometimesbut
theyreallsobusyIfeeltooguiltytoaskthemeveryday
soIalwaysthoughtitwouldbegreattohaveafriendtoplayboardgameswith
tofinallyhavesomeonetoplaywithfeelslikeacompletedream!
Oh, um. Okay...
isthereaboardgameyoulike?
adicegame?
acardgame?
acooperativeone?
acompetitiveone?
IhaveeverytypesojusttellmeandIllgetitreadyrightaway
I-I might not have it on me, but I have it at home, so please just tell me...
I-I might not look like much, but I'm quite confident that I own almost every board game out there!
R-Right. Do you have anything we can play here right now...?
Of course! I'll get it ready right away!
...And so, I returned after playing board games with Aronne at a nearby cafe.

chat.t: Hello, {player}
I-I'm sorry for someone like me to ask this of you, but by any chance...
Would you be able to play a board game with me today...?

o: Sure, why not.
I happen to have some free time.

chat.t: R-Really...?

o: Where should I go?

chat.t: Just a moment!
I'll decide on a time and place and let you know right away!

lines.t: I-I brought a new game today...
Hold on.
E-Eek?!
D-Do you not like this game...?
No, it's not that...  This is a bar.
Bloody Mary
Don't tell me... is this your place?
Ah, y-yes. That's r-right.
This room was originally at the edge of our mansion, but we converted it into a bar...
Y-You might have visited our shop before... but you've probably never seen me.
I rarely leave my room when it's crowded...
I suppose that makes sense.
But why did you call me here? We could have just gone to your room.
W-W-What?!!
...I-I think that's still a bit too early...
...O-Once I'm mentally prepared! I-I'll invite you then...!
Well, suit yourself.
Whew...
T-Then, I'll first explain the game I prepared this time.
I won this round too!
You're really good.
Not to brag, but I'm quite confident when it comes to board games.
Since I play them at home every day.
...By myself.
...Ahem.
Actually, it's pretty impressive that you can enjoy them all by yourself.
U-Um, excuse me!
I know it's a bit strange to suddenly ask this, but...
W-Why do you play board games with me?
Huh?
O-Of course, playing with {player} is super-duper fun for me, and I look forward to it every day...
{player}, I thought it might not be very fun for you...
Since I win every time... a-and I felt like letting you win on purpose would be rude...
Winning is fun, but...
You don't have to win for it to be fun.
I-Is that so...?
I-I've almost never lost, so I wouldn't know...
(Is she for real?)
Of course, I haven't played board games with other people very much, but...
Still... I-I was wondering whether {player} is really having fun too...
I was worried that you might be h-hanging out with me out of pity, even though you're bored...
You don't need to worry about that.
If it weren't fun, I wouldn't have even come near here in the first place.
I-Is that so...
Hmm, if it bothers you that much...
How about we do it my way next time?
...W-What?

chat.t: Hello, {player}
Do you remember our promise to play a board game today?

o: I'm on my way.

chat.t: Okay!
Just like you said last time...
We're adding a special twist today, right?
I'm so excited!

lines.t: Bloody Mary
W-Welcome. Ehehe...!
I got everything ready, just like you asked!
Great. Are you mentally prepared too?
M-Mentally prepared...?
Y-Yes. I'm not entirely sure, but... I-I think so...!
Let's go then.
We're playing in your room today, right?
Okay!
...Ah! B-Before that.
That "method" {player} mentioned last time...
I-I was wondering if you could give me a little sneak peek...
I-I wanted to ask you the whole time! But I held back and waited for today...!
Well, don't get your hopes up too much.
We're just adding a slightly unusual rule.
A-An unusual rule...!
I just brought over something that was popular where I used to live.
A l-local rule, I see!
S-So, what is this rule...?!
The loser has to grant any single wish of the winner.
A w-wish...!
I-Is that it?
Yeah.
There's no complete genre shift or a totally redesigned winning strategy... o-or anything like that?
Nope. Told ya, don't get your hopes up too high.
Ah, I see.
(...Why do I feel slightly annoyed?)
...Ahem, anyway, a rule like this makes it a lot more exciting for me.
I-If you say so...
...A-About that wish.
Would a wish like asking you to eat bell peppers for me be allowed...?
Sure.
...! T-Then, could I also ask you to find an extremely rare board game for me...?!
Of course.
W-Wow...! I think I understand what you mean by it being more exciting now!
So, how about it? Want to play a round with a wish on the line?
T-Then let's go to my room!
I'll explain the rules on the way!
Aronne's Room
I won!
This means you have to grant my wish, right...?
(How is she seriously this good? I even used my ultimate board-flip move???)
Y-Yeah. A deal's a deal...
Hehe, my wish is...
To play board games with me here again next time...!
...Huh?
Are you sure you're fine with a simple wish like that?
I feel like someone like me would get scolded for asking for too much...
...A-And just being able to enjoy a board game with someone else makes me so happy!
So, I want to feel this happiness for just a little bit longer...!
...Is that okay?
Of course it is.
I can easily do that much.
...Ehehe.
Is it a promise?

chat.t: Um...
Are you free tomorrow?

o: Huh? Was tomorrow our day to play board games?

chat.t: No, but...
Actually, I found something I really wanted on a secondhand market site.
I pre-ordered it before I knew it...
Apparently, it's a really old board game, so I thought it would be safer to meet in person to trade.
Could you possibly come with me tomorrow...?

o: Wait a second.
You're going outside? You?

chat.t: Yes...
Is that not okay...?
Thank you so much for coming with me today!
Thanks to you, I brought it home safely.
I read more of the manual afterward, and there are so many interesting things in it.
Like how players who become married couples using the marriage card get restrictions on their action commands.

o: Don't study that board game too deeply...

lines.t: Somewhere in Vermont
T-Thank you very much...!
Ehehe...! This is the legendary ancient board game, <New Family Life>!
...Was that person a scammer?
It looks like they gave us garbage instead of a board game.
I-It does look a bit worn on the outside, but...
It's an amazing ancient relic that even collectors struggle to get ahold of!
And what really matters is what's on the inside...!
The inside looked the same... It feels like one wrong move and it'll break.
Won't we be unable to even play the game like this?
I-It's fine. The important part is analyzing the components and the game board...
Once we deduce the rules based on that...  w-we can just make a copy!
Oh, I see.
Ehehe... U-Usually, there isn't much information about old board games like this.
Most of them don't even have instruction manuals... and they often have missing pieces or faded boards...
B-But finding a way to make up the rules anyway is exactly what makes board games so charming!
...I think you're the only one who can actually do that.
So, what are you doing right now?
Ah, I was reading the manual, but... I-I don't really get it.
I thought I was lucky because this one came with a manual, but...
Aww... I guess the terminology used in this game is so unique that it's hard to understand...
What is it?
Hmm... For e-example, when players form a party under certain conditions...
They get a special status effect called... 'Newlyweds'...?
Newlyweds? You mean marriage?
M-Marriage? What is that...
Uh... It's like two people who love each other forming a party that can't be disbanded? Something like that.
Ah! Y-You're right!
The card required to form the party is indeed named 'Marriage'...!
{player}, h-how did you know that?!
Huh...? Ah, well...
It was popular...? Where I used to live.
(...Does this world not even have the concept of marriage?)
I-I see...! You're amazing!
T-Then! Please take a look at this too!
The players who used that 'Marriage' card are called... a 'Married Couple'...!
Then, is 'having a baby' the final victory condition?!
It gives an additional 1,000 points upon completion... which is a massive bonus point payout...!
...Uh, well. I'm not so sure about that.
Ehehe, so there are things even {player} doesn't know.
D-Don't worry! I'll definitely figure out what 'having a baby' means!
...Is this a prank camera by any chance?
W-What? A prank... camera...?
Never mind...
B-But {player}... your expression has been a bit troubled for a while...
Do you not r-really like this game...?
It's not that, I just find it fascinating.
...Hehe, that's a relief.
Now that I think about it, it r-really is fascinating. Since you already knew the setup for this game...
A-Actually, I bought this <New Family Life> so I could play it with {player}.
Oh, is that so?
So, once I get home... I'm going to start analyzing it right away!
I-It might take a little time, but I'll study up quickly!
When that time comes, you'll play another game with me, right...?
...Sure, sure. I got it.
Listening to you actually reminded me of a certain game.
R-Really?! Is it a board game? What's the name?
I'll tell you once I organize my thoughts.
For now, let's head back.
Ehehe, okay...!
I'll be waiting!

chat.t: Hello, {player}
I'm really looking forward to our board game plans today!

o: Oh, right.
I'll bring the game we're playing today.

chat.t: Wow! Really?
Is it by any chance that game you mentioned before?

o: Maybe.
Anyway, you can look forward to it.

chat.t: Okay!
This game was way too hard...
I didn't really understand what the lines on the cards meant,
and I kept bumping into {player}...
And I'm so frustrated that I lost, too.

o: That's how you grow step by step.
But it was fun, right?

chat.t: Yes! It was fun!
So this is what people mean when they say you don't have to win to have fun.

o: Let me know if you want to play again sometime.
Actually, why don't we just play again tomorrow?

chat.t: Please give me a break for a while...

lines.t: (I lost last time... but today is different.)
(With "this," even Aronne won't find it easy.)
Bloody Mary
Oh, hello!
Ehehe... the board game {player} brought...!
I've been so, so excited that I haven't been able to sit still!
Yeah, I brought another game that was popular back where I used to live.
Th-That's amazing!
{player}, it seems like there's nothing your old home didn't have...!
S-Should we go straight to my room, then?
Wait. Before that, take this.
Y-Yes?
...W-What is this?
A roulette, drawing cards... and instructions?
This one requires a bit of background knowledge.
Simply put, you place your hands and feet on designated spots and do some roleplaying...
...I-I think I understand the rules for the most part.
Hehe, and you mixed in the settings from <New Family Life>, didn't you?
Something like that.
{player}, you're really amazing! To come up with a game that looks this fun...!
B-But having to move my hands and feet all over the place...
Huuu... I'm so clumsy and uncoordinated...
You've got to challenge yourself with things like this.
You never know when or what kind of board game you'll have to play next.
Ugh... Sh-Should we give it a try, then?
The space to move around is... well, reasonably wide...
Ah, I think I forgot to mention, but I'll be getting on the board with you.
Since we take turns doing it.
Whaaaat!!??
